lines.en: Okay, so when you're done with your tea,
I'll look at the leaves and tell you your fortune.
I didn't know you read tea leaves.
Oh, yeah, I've done it for years.
I actually stopped because I was so accurate.
You know, and, you know, one of the great joys of life
is its wondrous unpredictability, you know?
And also, tea tends to give me the trots.
Which can mean either a promotion or a violent death.
I'm the head chef. I can't get promoted.
Um, oh, okay. I see a circle.
Oh, which can either mean you're having a baby
or you're going to make a scientific discovery.
Well, I have been spending a lot of time in the lab.
Oh, I'm going to meet a guy.
And he's going to be the man of my dreams.
Probably not the guy I had a dream about last night.
Oh, wait a second, you guys.
For the last couple weeks, I haven't seen that guy everywhere I go.
We take the same bus, we go to the same bookstore, same dry cleaner.
And he totally checked you out, and he is so cute.
Mine is a picture of the village people.
Certainly have been seeing a lot of each other lately.
Maybe we'll be seeing each other at dinner tomorrow night.
Oh, isn't it funny how we kept running into each other?
It's as if someone really wants us to be together.
So, tell me a little bit about yourself.
Well, I'm a masseuse, and I used to work at this place.
I, I, I've lived in New York somewhat wildly, I guess, for, um, most since I was 14.
It's just that you have the most beautiful eyes.
Look, you're coming on a little strong, but I'm going to give you the benefit of the doubt,
because it seems the universe really wants us to be together.
So, why don't we just start over, okay?
And you can just tell me about yourself.
I write erotic novels for children.
Oh, also, you might be interested to know that I have a PhD.
